description: Stolen cloud credentials could expose synthetic records.
mitigation: Require multi-factor authentication and rotate exposed credentials.

description: Misuse of reusable payment links could cause disputed sandbox transactions.
mitigation: Limit each payment link to one approved transaction.

description: A lapsed domain registration could interrupt the example site.
mitigation: Enable automatic renewal and verify the billing contact quarterly.

description: An incomplete backup could prevent recovery of synthetic files.
mitigation: Test restoration of a sample backup.

description: A single operator could delay routine approvals when unavailable.
mitigation: Assign a trained backup operator and test the escalation path.

description: Excessive access could allow unauthorized changes to a synthetic environment.
mitigation: Remove unused grants and require approval for role changes.

description: A service outage could delay delivery of example records.
mitigation: Test the documented alternate submission process.

description: An incomplete runbook could slow a routine operational task.
mitigation: Review the runbook with a second operator.

description: Missing audit logs could obscure changes to the sample register.
mitigation: Verify audit log collection with a synthetic change.

description: An expired vendor agreement could suspend access to a test service.
mitigation: Record the renewal date and assign an accountable owner.

description: An incorrect report recipient could delay a synthetic review.
mitigation: Verify the role mailbox before distributing a report.

description: Unpatched software could expose the example application.
mitigation: Apply the supported security update and check the version.
